options_evaluated: Single-polymer post-consumer recycled plastic with lightweight structural ribbing
Virgin multi-layered composite plastic with metallic coatings
Bio-composite with non-recyclable flame retardant additives
assessments.recommendation: Single-polymer post-consumer recycled plastic with lightweight structural ribbing
assessments.rationale: This option directly supports parameter (h) use of recycled materials, parameter (d) design for recycling, and parameter (t) lightweight design. Page 80 states that lightweight design is expressed through the 'reduction of material consumption, load- and stress-optimisation of structures... use of lower density or high-strength materials... with regard to material savings, recycling and other circularity aspects'. Utilizing a single-polymer recycled plastic avoids substances of concern that make the 'recycling process more complicated, costly, environmentally impactful' (Page 35, parameter (f)), thereby reducing the product's overall material footprint (Page 2, parameter (o)) and carbon footprint (Page 2, parameter (m)).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage (processing post-consumer recycled resins can introduce melt-flow variability compared to virgin plastics, increasing scrap rates) and Use stage (thinner structural ribbing may reduce impact resistance during high-stress dropped events).

options_evaluated: Permanent chemical adhesives and ultrasonic welding
Reversible snap-fits and standardized metal screws
assessments.recommendation: Reversible snap-fits and standardized metal screws
assessments.rationale: This selection aligns with parameter (d) design for recycling and parameter (o) material footprint. Page 79 highlights that ease of repair, reuse, and recycling is expressed through the 'ease of non-destructive disassembly and re-assembly' and the reduction of the 'number and complexity of processes and whether specialised tools are needed'. Standardized, reversible fasteners prevent material contamination during end-of-life sorting and minimize the lifecycle environmental footprint (Page 33, parameter (m)).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage (reversible fasteners increase parts count and assembly time, raising production costs) and Use stage (vibrations from the vacuum motor may loosen mechanical fasteners over time, potentially impacting structural reliability).

options_evaluated: High-efficiency synchronous motor with rare-earth magnets and glued assemblies
Standardized brushed DC motor with modular, non-glued copper windings and recycled aluminum casing
Integrated brushless motor with potted electronics and overmolded housing
assessments.recommendation: Standardized brushed DC motor with modular, non-glued copper windings and recycled aluminum casing
assessments.rationale: This design supports parameter (k) incorporation of used components, parameter (h) use of recycled materials, and parameter (d) design for recycling. Page 79 notes that 'ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing and refurbishment' is facilitated by the 'use of standard components' and 'ease of non-destructive disassembly and re-assembly'. Avoiding glued assemblies and potted electronics ensures that substances of concern do not make the 'recycling process more complicated, costly, environmentally impactful' (Page 35, parameter (f)).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use stage (brushed DC motors exhibit lower energy efficiency and shorter operating lifetimes than brushless alternatives, which conflicts with energy efficiency and durability goals).

options_evaluated: Passive cooling via structural ventilation slots and lightweight aluminum heat sinks
Active liquid cooling loop with fluorinated thermal fluids
Phase-change material (PCM) pouches with chemical flame retardants
assessments.recommendation: Passive cooling via structural ventilation slots and lightweight aluminum heat sinks
assessments.rationale: This approach satisfies parameter (t) lightweight design and parameter (f) use of substances of concern. Page 80 states that lightweight design is achieved through 'reduction of material consumption... integration of functions within the material or into a single product component'. Passive cooling avoids fluorinated fluids or chemical flame retardants that act as substances of concern, which can 'impair the technical properties or functionalities... of the recycled material' (Page 35, parameter (f)), while minimizing the overall material footprint (Page 2, parameter (o)).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use stage (passive thermal management may result in higher internal operating temperatures, which can degrade motor efficiency and accelerate the aging of electronic components).

options_evaluated: Highly modular architecture with standardized, clip-in sub-assemblies and clear material coding
Monolithic integrated design with minimized internal wiring and structural housing
Semi-modular design with proprietary fasteners and software-locked components
assessments.recommendation: Highly modular architecture with standardized, clip-in sub-assemblies and clear material coding
assessments.rationale: This architecture directly supports parameter (d) design for recycling and parameter (o) material footprint. Page 79 states that ease of repair, reuse, and refurbishment is enhanced by 'modular structures, use of standard components, use of component and material coding standards for the identification of components and materials'. Standardized material coding ensures high-purity sorting at end-of-life, reducing the material footprint (Page 2, parameter (o)) and overall environmental footprint (Page 33, parameter (m)).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Distribution and Packaging stage (highly modular designs with separate housings and clip-in interfaces typically increase the overall weight and volume of the product, which conflicts with parameter (j) and increases transport emissions).

options_evaluated: Mains-powered corded design with integrated cord reel and no chemical battery
Removable and modular Lithium-Iron-Phosphate (LFP) battery pack with standard cell format
Integrated, non-removable Lithium-Cobalt-Oxide (LCO) pouch battery pack
assessments.recommendation: Mains-powered corded design with integrated cord reel and no chemical battery
assessments.rationale: This option best serves the material and design stage by completely eliminating battery chemistry, which contains substances of concern. Page 9 emphasizes that the 'chemical composition of products largely determines... the possibility for their reuse or for recovery once they become waste' and calls for 'substances of concern in products to be minimised'. Eliminating the battery avoids hazardous waste generation (Page 80, parameter (r)), significantly reduces the product's material footprint (Page 2, parameter (o)), and minimizes its life-cycle environmental footprint (Page 33, parameter (m)).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use stage (corded vacuums restrict user mobility and convenience compared to cordless models, which may reduce market adoption and user satisfaction).
